article.headline: Omaha beats South Dakota State 80-71
article.description: — Paul Djobet had 16 points and 10 rebounds as Omaha beat South Dakota State 80-71 on Wednesday night.

categories.description: South Dakota State Jackrabbits @ Omaha Mavericks

event.description: South Dakota State Jackrabbits @ Omaha Mavericks

keywords: South Dakota State Jackrabbits @ Omaha Mavericks
article.story: OMAHA, Neb. -- — Paul Djobet had 16 points and 10 rebounds as Omaha beat South Dakota State 80-71 on Wednesday night. Tony Osburn shot 5 for 14, including 3 for 10 from beyond the arc to add 15 points for the Mavericks (11-12, 4-4 Summit League). Grant Stubblefield had 13 points and shot 3 of 8 from the field and 7 of 8 from the free-throw line. Damon Wilkinson led the way for the Jackrabbits (10-12, 3-4) with 24 points. Kalen Garry added 22 points and four assists for South Dakota State. Bubz Alvarez finished with 10 points, six rebounds and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
